description: A bun global on Linux, through a directory osquery's npm_packages never searches on its own.
why: One variable: 71 proves @google/gemini-cli through npm's own prefix, so the only thing this run can be wrong about is the directory. file >= 1 is the ~/.bun dotdir the state-directory branch reports. claude-code is forbidden because nothing installs it, and bun hoists gemini-cli's optional packages beside it, so none of them may be claimed as an agent.
known_gaps: bun blocks the lifecycle scripts of untrusted packages, and gemini-cli has none. Whether a global that needs its postinstall is still reported after bun skipped it is not proved here.
A global directory moved by BUN_INSTALL_GLOBAL_DIR or bunfig's globalDir is not searched.
Packages run through bunx and never installed land in bun's cache, the same gap npx has, noted in osquery/queries/filesystem.sql.
